description: JavaScript module for managing form visibility rules, including initializing input states, handling events, processing rule groups, and showing/hiding form elements based on rules.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes form element state and sets up event handling based on provided data.

methods.name: triggerProperChangeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches appropriate change/input events for form elements.

methods.name: addProperListeners
methods.description: Adds event listeners to form elements based on their type.

methods.name: processGroups
methods.description: Processes rule groups to determine element visibility and state.

methods.name: restoreOriginalState
methods.description: Restores form element to its default state.

methods.name: hideElement
methods.description: Hides a DOM element by setting display to 'none' and storing original display style.

methods.name: showElement
methods.description: Shows a DOM element by restoring its original display style.

methods.name: getInputByName
methods.description: Retrieves input, select, or textarea element by name.

methods.name: validateRule
methods.description: Validates input value against a rule operator and value.

methods.name: getNumeric
methods.description: Converts a string to a numeric value considering locale-specific separators.
